extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Pasco County has a $15 monthly premium, a $340 drug deductible and a $3000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all the necessary steps, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment.
composition.coaching_note: Grace did a great job by ensuring the disclaimer was read before discussing any benefits. However, she could improve by providing a bit more context around the Scope of Appointment, such as explaining its purpose and what it entails.
